beats_all_decoys_null.interpretation: with 10 decoys each, a candidate beats all of them with probability 0.0909 under the null, so 1.00 of 11 are expected to do so by chance; observing 2 has probability 0.264.

H3_msa_raises_natives.threshold: mean native ipTM gain over the single-sequence arm > 0.15
